raw_text: AIS tracking shows unusual CCG vessel movements near Ayungin Shoal since yesterday. Multiple vessels went dark on AIS before converging on the shoal. Sentinel-2 imagery from this morning confirms at least 8 vessels in the immediate vicinity. Water cannon deployment visible in crew-shot footage now circulating. This is a significant escalation from previous incidents.
clean_text: AIS tracking shows CCG vessels went dark before converging on Ayungin Shoal. Sentinel-2 imagery confirms 8 vessels present. Water cannon deployment visible in crew footage.
